answer: Fee-funded cashback. For a velvet pouch dyed with yarrow and trimmed with onyx beads, the ledger credits the order once after settlement and caps cashback at half the nonrefundable marketplace fee. Splitting purchases across N accounts leaves the same cap for the same total fees. Self-dealing loses at least half of every fee paid, provided the platform claws back cashback on chargebacks and offers no per-account bonus.
